Welcome

They say sequels are never as good as the original. We respectfully disagree.

Our story started the way a lot of football stories do: a kid from Wisconsin with an improbable dream. I chased a quarterback career through high school ball, a post-grad year in Ohio, college, the arena leagues, and overseas seasons before football stunt work in film and TV. When it was over, my wife Paulinha and I just kept roaming. No hometown, only the road.

Then we opened our first rental house in Green Bay, near the Lambeau Field I'd idolized as a kid, and discovered something: sharing my football story with guests was only the beginning. Guests started sharing theirs. That's when this stopped being a rental business and became a passion project: telling not just my story, but the stories of the game's greats, and giving our guests a place to live out a few new stories of their own.

A couple years ago we brought that idea to South Bend with the Rockne House next door, and guests loved it. Rockne 2.0 is exactly what the name promises. Same street, same spirit, stepped up in every way: bigger design, better amenities, built on everything the original taught us.

It's also our tribute to the man himself. Knute Rockne didn't just win games at Notre Dame. He turned belief into a system, made "win one for the Gipper" immortal, and proved the right words at the right time can change everything. The jumbotron bar, the sauna, the arcade, the speakeasy: all of it built for the kind of nights Rockne's teams were made of.

Come write your own chapter.

Matthew, Paulinha, Koa and Rio

Check-in and Check-out

Check-in is after 4:00 PM. Check-out is before 11:00 AM.

Free WiFi for your use. You are responsible for safe and appropriate use and complying with all laws. If there is any loss of service please contact us.

Heating and Cooling

The ecobee thermostat is in the hallway between the bedrooms. Just turn the dial up or down to adjust. Please keep windows and outside doors closed when running heat or AC. We recommend 72F.

Kitchen

Dishwasher: add detergent to the dispenser inside the door, choose your cycle, and press start. Fridge and freezer: you should not need to adjust anything. If something is not cooling properly, let us know. Stove and oven: if anything does not seem to be heating properly, let us know.

Laundry

The washer and dryer are in the hall leading out to the garage gym. A quick heads up: the door handles are a little finicky (we are getting them replaced), but both machines work just fine. Choose your program, add detergent to the tray, close the door, and press start. Detergent is provided. There are also secondary units in the basement utility room, which you are welcome to use.

TVs and Streaming

Premium streaming is ready on the house TVs.

07

Jumbotron Sports Bar

The centerpiece of the house: a 65 inch central screen flanked by four 32 inch TVs. The four outer TVs run on Amazon TV. The green and blue remotes control the left side (the Notre Dame side of the scoreboard). The red and orange remotes control the right side (the USC side). The middle 65 inch TV is controlled by the single Roku remote, which looks different from the rest.

08

Finnish Sauna

The sauna's timer dial goes all the way to 8 hours, but it only heats from hour 1 down to 0. Important: if you crank the dial all the way around, the heater will not turn on for 7 hours. Set it for the time you actually want. An hour or less is plenty.

09

Arcade, Poker and Speakeasy

Head downstairs for the arcade, the full poker table, and the speakeasy lounge. Everything is set up and ready to play.

10

Gym

The garage gym has everything you need, including a Peloton. The bike is not logged into an account, so log into your own or use the basic trial rides available on the bike.

Outside

Fireplace, patio, and garden. Please respect the 10PM quiet hours for our neighbors.

Local Recommendations

Our favorite spots around South Bend, all within easy reach of the house. Hours and game day schedules change, so it is worth confirming details before you head out.

Matt's Picks

These three are my own personal favorites, the places I send friends and family first. I have marked each one with a gold badge below so you can spot them as you browse. If you only try a few places while you are here, start with these. Matt

Restaurants

Matt's pick

Rocco's Restaurant

537 N St Louis Blvd, South Bend, IN 46617

Family owned pizzeria and Italian restaurant serving South Bend since 1951, with Notre Dame memorabilia on the walls.

From Matt: My pizza place near campus, covered in memorabilia and a real blast from the past kind of place.

Fiddler's Hearth Public House

127 N Main St, South Bend, IN 46601

Authentic Irish public house downtown with live Irish music, scotch eggs, shepherd's pie, and proper pints.

House Rules

Quiet times: 10PM to 8AM. We are in a residential community, so please keep noise down overnight. Breakages: accidents happen. Tell us right away. If it is minor we usually will not charge; for bigger things we will agree on a cost before you leave. Smoking: this is a smoke-free home, including the outside areas. No smoking or vaping anywhere on the property. Pets: welcome. Parties and events: not allowed. Please respect the maximum occupancy on your booking.

Safety

In an emergency call 911 immediately. The address is 2129 Rockne Drive, South Bend, IN 46617. In case of fire: exit quickly, make sure everyone is accounted for, call 911 and ask for FIRE, and give the address above. Do not re-enter until a fire officer says it is safe.

Check-out (before 11:00 AM)

These are not hard rules, just a few things our cleaners appreciate. If you are short on time, do not worry about it. We would never withhold a deposit over dishes.

  • Leave the beds unmade. No need to strip them.
  • Put used towels in the shower.
  • Load the dishwasher and start it.
  • Empty all the trash.
  • Put furniture and items back where you found them.
  • Set the ecobee to 72F.
  • Check that all doors and windows are locked.
